description: A single go/no-go decision for a release: runs the repository hardening and the supply-chain and licence audit over the same artifacts, combines their findings, and returns a pass or block decision with the blocking findings named. At the end of a release cycle, when a single reproducible pass/block decision is needed. Do not choose this when you need exploitability proven by running the code, or a legal opinion. Example requests: Give me a go/no-go decision for this release. | Is this project safe to ship? Check hardening and licences together. | Which findings block my release? | Run the release readiness gate over these artifacts.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

dockerfile.description: The customer's Dockerfile, as text. Supported: Dockerfile text. The container build file. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

infrastructure.description: The customer's infra.tf, as text. Supported: Terraform, CloudFormation or JSON. The infrastructure-as-code or cloud config. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

licences.description: The customer's licences.txt, as text. Supported: Text. Declared licences as 'dependency=LICENCE' lines. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

manifest.description: The customer's manifest.json, as text. Supported: JSON or text. The dependency manifest. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

workflow.description: The customer's ci-workflow.yml, as text. Supported: GitHub Actions or generic YAML. The CI workflow definition. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_release_readiness_gate

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: Release readiness gate
